// mobile/src/context/AuthContext.tsx

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';

export interface UserAccount {
  id?: number;
  user_id?: number;
  username: string;
  first_name?: string;
  last_name?: string;
  full_name?: string;
  faculty_name?: string;
  faculty_id?: string;
  email?: string;
  role?: string;
  contact_number?: string;
  qr_token?: string;
  bound_device_id?: string;
  school_name?: string;
  division?: string;
  department?: string;
  is_superuser?: boolean;
}

interface AuthContextType {
  user: UserAccount | null;
  token: string | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  deviceIdentity: { deviceId: string };
  login: (username: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  updateUser: (updatedFields: Partial<UserAccount>) => Promise<void>;
  refreshUser: () => Promise<void>;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType>({} as AuthContextType);

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<UserAccount | null>(null);
  const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);

  const deviceIdentity = {
    deviceId: user?.bound_device_id || '',
  };

  // 1. Startup: Test stored token against Django before permitting entry
  useEffect(() => {
    const loadSession = async () => {
      try {
        const storedToken = await AsyncStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        if (!storedToken) {
          setUser(null);
          setToken(null);
          return;
        }

        // Validate token with Django database
        const res = await apiClient.get('/api/me/', {
          headers: { Authorization: `Token ${storedToken}` },
        });

        if (res.data && res.data.username) {
          setToken(storedToken);
          setUser(res.data);
          await AsyncStorage.setItem('auth_user', JSON.stringify(res.data));
        } else {
          throw new Error('Unverified session token');
        }
      } catch {
        // Clear unverified/stale sessions so user stays on Login
        await AsyncStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
        await AsyncStorage.removeItem('auth_user');
        setToken(null);
        setUser(null);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadSession();
  }, []);

  // 2. Strict Database Verification
  const login = async (username: string, password: string) => {
    // This MUST reject if Django rejects the credentials
    const res = await apiClient.post('/api/auth/login/', {
      username: username.trim(),
      password: password.trim(),
    });

    const receivedToken = res.data?.token;
    const userData = res.data?.user;

    // Fail immediately if the backend did not confirm a user
    if (!receivedToken || !userData || !userData.username) {
      throw new Error('Server rejected credentials: User not found in database.');
    }

    // Only set state after receiving a valid 200 OK from Django
    setToken(receivedToken);
    setUser(userData);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem('auth_token', receivedToken);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem('auth_user', JSON.stringify(userData));
  };

  const logout = async () => {
    setToken(null);
    setUser(null);
    await AsyncStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
    await AsyncStorage.removeItem('auth_user');
  };

  const updateUser = async (updatedFields: Partial<UserAccount>) => {
    setUser((prev) => {
      if (!prev) return null;
      const firstName = updatedFields.first_name ?? prev.first_name ?? '';
      const lastName = updatedFields.last_name ?? prev.last_name ?? '';
      const fullName = `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim() || prev.username;

      const merged: UserAccount = {
        ...prev,
        ...updatedFields,
        faculty_name: fullName,
        full_name: fullName,
      };

      AsyncStorage.setItem('auth_user', JSON.stringify(merged));
      return merged;
    });
  };

  const refreshUser = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get('/api/me/');
      if (res.data) {
        await updateUser(res.data);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore background refresh errors
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        token,
        isLoading,
        deviceIdentity,
        login,
        logout,
        updateUser,
        refreshUser,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext);

import React from 'react';
import { createNativeStackNavigator } from '@react-navigation/native-stack';

import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import LoginScreen from '../screens/LoginScreen';
import MainTabNavigator from './MainTabNavigator';
import ProfileSettingsScreen from '../screens/ProfileSettingsScreen';

export type RootStackParamList = {
  Login: undefined;
  Main: undefined;
  ProfileSettings: undefined;
};

const Stack = createNativeStackNavigator<RootStackParamList>();

export const AppNavigator: React.FC = () => {
  const { user, isLoading } = useAuth();

  if (isLoading) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <Stack.Navigator screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }}>
      {!user ? (
        <Stack.Screen name="Login" component={LoginScreen} />
      ) : (
        <>
          <Stack.Screen name="Main" component={MainTabNavigator} />
          <Stack.Screen
            name="ProfileSettings"
            component={ProfileSettingsScreen}
            options={{
              headerShown: false,
              animation: 'slide_from_right',
            }}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </Stack.Navigator>
  );
};

export default AppNavigator;

// mobile/src/screens/CalendarScreen.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  Switch,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ScrollView,
  Alert,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/theme';

interface CalendarException {
  id: string | number;
  type: 'SUSPENSION' | 'HOLIDAY' | 'EVENT';
  date: string;
  reason: string;
}

export const CalendarScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const [weekendRestEnabled, setWeekendRestEnabled] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<'SUSPENSION' | 'HOLIDAY' | 'EVENT'>('SUSPENSION');
  const [exceptionDate, setExceptionDate] = useState<string>(() => new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [exceptionReason, setExceptionReason] = useState<string>('');
  const [exceptions, setExceptions] = useState<CalendarException[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const fetchExceptions = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get('/api/calendar/exceptions/');
      const data = res.data?.results || res.data || [];
      setExceptions(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch {
      setExceptions([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchExceptions();
  }, [fetchExceptions]);

  const handleAddException = async () => {
    if (!exceptionReason.trim()) {
      Alert.alert('Missing Detail', 'Please enter a description or reason for this calendar override.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        type: selectedType,
        date: exceptionDate.trim(),
        reason: exceptionReason.trim(),
      };
      const res = await apiClient.post('/api/calendar/exceptions/', payload);
      const createdItem = res.data || { id: Date.now(), ...payload };
      setExceptions((prev) => [createdItem, ...prev]);
      setExceptionReason('');
      Alert.alert('Exception Saved', 'The date override has been saved to the school calendar.');
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.error || 'Could not save date exception.';
      Alert.alert('Save Failed', msg);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteException = async (id: string | number) => {
    try {
      await apiClient.delete(`/api/calendar/exceptions/${id}/`);
      setExceptions((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
    } catch {
      // Local removal fallback
      setExceptions((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
    }
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      <View style={styles.topHeader}>
        <View>
          <Text style={styles.screenTitle}>Class Calendar</Text>
          <Text style={styles.screenSub}>Attendance Schedules & Official Date Overrides</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.headerBadge}>
          <View style={styles.activeDot} />
          <Text style={styles.headerBadgeText}>DEPED CALENDAR</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {/* 1. Weekend Auto-Rest Switch */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.weekendCardRow}>
            <View style={styles.cardIconBox}>
              <Ionicons name="calendar" size={22} color={COLORS.primary} />
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 10 }}>
              <Text style={styles.cardHeading}>Automatic Weekend Rest Days</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardDetailText}>
                Excludes Saturdays and Sundays from mandatory classroom attendance logging
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Switch
              value={weekendRestEnabled}
              onValueChange={setWeekendRestEnabled}
              trackColor={{ false: '#cbd5e1', true: '#b8d6f0' }}
              thumbColor={weekendRestEnabled ? COLORS.primary : '#f8fafc'}
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* 2. Add Override Form Card */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderTitle}>ADD DATE OVERRIDE / SUSPENSION</Text>

          <View style={styles.fieldRow}>
            <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Effective Date (YYYY-MM-DD)</Text>
            <View style={styles.inputBox}>
              <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={17} color="#64748b" style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />
              <TextInput
                style={styles.inputText}
                value={exceptionDate}
                onChangeText={setExceptionDate}
                placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD"
                placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
              />
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.fieldRow}>
            <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Exception Category</Text>
            <View style={styles.typeSelectorRow}>
              {(['SUSPENSION', 'HOLIDAY', 'EVENT'] as const).map((type) => (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={type}
                  style={[styles.typePill, selectedType === type && styles.typePillActive]}
                  onPress={() => setSelectedType(type)}
                  activeOpacity={0.8}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.typePillText, selectedType === type && styles.typePillTextActive]}>
                    {type}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              ))}
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.fieldRow}>
            <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Reason / Official Memorandum</Text>
            <View style={[styles.inputBox, { height: 48 }]}>
              <Ionicons name="document-text-outline" size={17} color="#64748b" style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />
              <TextInput
                style={styles.inputText}
                placeholder="e.g. Typhoon Alert, Heat Index > 42°C, Intramurals"
                placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
                value={exceptionReason}
                onChangeText={setExceptionReason}
              />
            </View>
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.addOverrideBtn, submitting && styles.btnDisabled]}
            onPress={handleAddException}
            disabled={submitting}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
          >
            {submitting ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#ffffff" />
            ) : (
              <>
                <Ionicons name="add-circle-outline" size={18} color="#ffffff" style={{ marginRight: 6 }} />
                <Text style={styles.addOverrideBtnText}>Save Calendar Override</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* 3. Active Exceptions List */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.listHeaderRow}>
            <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderTitle}>
              ACTIVE DATE OVERRIDES ({exceptions.length})
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.listSubText}>Takes precedence over regular classes</Text>
          </View>

          {loading ? (
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.primary} style={{ marginVertical: 14 }} />
          ) : exceptions.length === 0 ? (
            <Text style={styles.noExceptionsText}>No special date overrides currently set in database.</Text>
          ) : (
            exceptions.map((item) => (
              <View key={String(item.id)} style={styles.exceptionItemRow}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.typeBadge,
                    item.type === 'SUSPENSION'
                      ? styles.badgeSuspension
                      : item.type === 'HOLIDAY'
                      ? styles.badgeHoliday
                      : styles.badgeEvent,
                  ]}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      styles.typeBadgeText,
                      item.type === 'SUSPENSION'
                        ? styles.textSuspension
                        : item.type === 'HOLIDAY'
                        ? styles.textHoliday
                        : styles.textEvent,
                    ]}
                  >
                    {item.type}
                  </Text>
                </View>

                <View style={{ flex: 1, marginHorizontal: 12 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.exceptionDateText}>{item.date}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.exceptionReasonText}>{item.reason}</Text>
                </View>

                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => handleDeleteException(item.id)}
                  style={styles.deleteBtn}
                  activeOpacity={0.7}
                >
                  <Ionicons name="trash-outline" size={17} color="#ef4444" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            ))
          )}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

// mobile/src/screens/DTRScreen.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  FlatList,
  RefreshControl,
  ActivityIndicator,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Alert,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';

interface DTRRow {
  date: string;
  day_name?: string;
  is_weekend?: boolean;
  am_in: string | null;
  am_out: string | null;
  pm_in: string | null;
  pm_out: string | null;
  undertime_minutes?: number | null;
  total_hours: number | null;
  remarks?: string;
}

export const DTRScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  const now = new Date();
  const currentYear = now.getFullYear();
  const currentMonthName = now.toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'long' });

  const [dtrLogs, setDtrLogs] = useState<DTRRow[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [dtrSubmitted, setDtrSubmitted] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [deptHeadApproved, setDeptHeadApproved] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const displayName =
    user?.full_name ||
    `${user?.first_name || ''} ${user?.last_name || ''}`.trim() ||
    user?.faculty_name ||
    user?.username ||
    '';

  const employeeId = user?.faculty_id || user?.username || '';

  const fetchDTR = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const monthNum = new Date().getMonth() + 1;
      const yearNum = new Date().getFullYear();
      const res = await apiClient.get(`/api/dtr/?month=${monthNum}&year=${yearNum}`);
      const raw = res.data;

      if (raw && typeof raw === 'object' && !Array.isArray(raw)) {
        setDtrSubmitted(Boolean(raw.dtr_submitted));
        setDeptHeadApproved(Boolean(raw.dept_head_approved));

        const rows = raw.daily_records || raw.results || raw.days || [];
        setDtrLogs(Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []);
      } else if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
        setDtrLogs(raw);
      } else {
        setDtrLogs([]);
      }
    } catch {
      setDtrLogs([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDTR();
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  const handleSubmitDTR = async () => {
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post('/api/dtr/', { action: 'SUBMIT_DTR' });
      setDtrSubmitted(true);
      Alert.alert('DTR Submitted', 'Your daily time record has been submitted for review.');
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.error || 'Could not submit DTR record.';
      Alert.alert('Submission Error', msg);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const totalRenderedHours = dtrLogs
    .reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.total_hours || 0), 0)
    .toFixed(1);

  const daysPresent = dtrLogs.filter((item) => (item.total_hours || 0) > 0).length;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      <View style={styles.topHeader}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Text style={styles.screenTitle}>Civil Service Form 48</Text>
          <Text style={styles.screenSub}>Daily Time Record • {currentMonthName} {currentYear}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.headerBadge}>
          <View style={styles.activeDot} />
          <Text style={styles.headerBadgeText}>DEPED CSC</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.statusCard}>
        <View style={styles.statusMetaRow}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <Text style={styles.facultyNameText}>{displayName}</Text>
            {employeeId ? <Text style={styles.facultySubText}>Employee ID: {employeeId}</Text> : null}
          </View>

          <View
            style={[
              styles.submissionPill,
              deptHeadApproved ? styles.pillApproved : dtrSubmitted ? styles.pillSubmitted : styles.pillDraft,
            ]}
          >
            <Text
              style={[
                styles.submissionPillText,
                deptHeadApproved ? styles.textApproved : dtrSubmitted ? styles.textSubmitted : styles.textDraft,
              ]}
            >
              {deptHeadApproved ? 'ENDORSED' : dtrSubmitted ? 'PENDING' : 'DRAFT'}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.metricsRibbon}>
          <View style={styles.metricItem}>
            <Text style={styles.metricLabel}>RENDERED</Text>
            <Text style={styles.metricVal}>{totalRenderedHours} hrs</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.metricDivider} />
          <View style={styles.metricItem}>
            <Text style={styles.metricLabel}>DAYS LOGGED</Text>
            <Text style={styles.metricVal}>{daysPresent} days</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.metricDivider} />
          <View style={styles.metricItem}>
            <Text style={styles.metricLabel}>UNDERTIME</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.metricVal, { color: '#059669' }]}>0 mins</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {!dtrSubmitted && (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.submitDtrBtn, submitting && styles.btnDisabled]}
            onPress={handleSubmitDTR}
            disabled={submitting}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
          >
            {submitting ? (
              <ActivityIndicator color="#ffffff" size="small" />
            ) : (
              <>
                <Ionicons name="document-attach-outline" size={16} color="#ffffff" style={{ marginRight: 6 }} />
                <Text style={styles.submitDtrBtnText}>Submit DTR for Approval</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      </View>

      {loading ? (
        <View style={styles.loadingBox}>
          <ActivityIndicator color="#004b87" size="large" />
          <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Compiling daily logs...</Text>
        </View>
      ) : dtrLogs.length === 0 ? (
        <View style={styles.emptyContainer}>
          <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={38} color="#94a3b8" />
          <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No attendance records recorded for this month.</Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={dtrLogs}
          keyExtractor={(item) => item.date}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl refreshing={refreshing} onRefresh={() => { setRefreshing(true); fetchDTR(); }} colors={['#004b87']} />
          }
          renderItem={({ item }) => {
            const hasHours = Boolean(item.total_hours && item.total_hours > 0);

            return (
              <View style={[styles.rowCard, item.is_weekend && styles.weekendCard]}>
                <View style={styles.dateRowHeader}>
                  <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                    <Ionicons
                      name={item.is_weekend ? 'sunny-outline' : hasHours ? 'checkbox' : 'time-outline'}
                      size={15}
                      color={item.is_weekend ? '#94a3b8' : hasHours ? '#004b87' : '#64748b'}
                    />
                    <Text style={[styles.dateText, item.is_weekend && { color: '#64748b' }]}>
                      {item.date} {item.day_name ? `(${item.day_name})` : ''}
                    </Text>
                  </View>

                  {item.is_weekend ? (
                    <View style={styles.weekendPill}>
                      <Text style={styles.weekendPillText}>REST DAY</Text>
                    </View>
                  ) : hasHours ? (
                    <View style={styles.hoursPill}>
                      <Text style={styles.hoursPillText}>{item.total_hours} hrs</Text>
                    </View>
                  ) : (
                    <Text style={styles.pendingText}>{item.remarks || '--'}</Text>
                  )}
                </View>

                {!item.is_weekend && (
                  <View style={styles.timesGrid}>
                    <View style={styles.timeCol}>
                      <Text style={styles.timeLabel}>AM IN</Text>
                      <Text style={[styles.timeVal, item.am_in && styles.timeValActive]}>
                        {item.am_in || '--:--'}
                      </Text>
                    </View>

                    <View style={styles.timeCol}>
                      <Text style={styles.timeLabel}>AM OUT</Text>
                      <Text style={[styles.timeVal, item.am_out && styles.timeValActive]}>
                        {item.am_out || '--:--'}
                      </Text>
                    </View>

                    <View style={styles.timeCol}>
                      <Text style={styles.timeLabel}>PM IN</Text>
                      <Text style={[styles.timeVal, item.pm_in && styles.timeValActive]}>
                        {item.pm_in || '--:--'}
                      </Text>
                    </View>

                    <View style={styles.timeCol}>
                      <Text style={styles.timeLabel}>PM OUT</Text>
                      <Text style={[styles.timeVal, item.pm_out && styles.timeValActive]}>
                        {item.pm_out || '--:--'}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                )}
              </View>
            );
          }}
        />
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
  topHeader: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: 18, paddingVertical: 12, backgroundColor: '#ffffff', borderBottomWidth: 1, borderBottomColor: '#e2e8f0' },
  screenTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '800', color: '#003460', letterSpacing: -0.3 },

  listContent: { paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 10, paddingBottom: 32 },
  loadingBox: { alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', paddingVertical: 60 },
  loadingText: { fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b', marginTop: 8 },
  emptyContainer: { alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', paddingVertical: 60 },
  emptyText: { fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b', marginTop: 8 },
  rowCard: { backgroundColor: '#ffffff', borderRadius: 12, padding: 12, marginBottom: 8, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#e2e8f0' },

  dateRowHeader: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingBottom: 6 },

// mobile/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ScrollView,
  RefreshControl,
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  StatusBar,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { sendLiveHeartbeat } from '../services/telemetryService';
import { getUnsyncedCount } from '../services/offlineQueue';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/theme';

const schoolLogo = require('../../assets/logo.svg');

interface StudentRosterItem {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  full_name: string;
  attendance_status: string;
}

interface SectionRoster {
  schedule_id: number;
  section_id: number;
  section_name: string;
  subject_name: string;
  subject_code: string;
  room: string;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
  total_students: number;
  students: StudentRosterItem[];
}

export const HomeScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { user, refreshUser } = useAuth();

  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionRoster[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [telemetryLoading, setTelemetryLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [offlineCount, setOfflineCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [lastSyncTime, setLastSyncTime] = useState<string>('');
  const [isInsideGeofence, setIsInsideGeofence] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Dynamic user data
  const displayName =
    user?.full_name ||
    `${user?.first_name || ''} ${user?.last_name || ''}`.trim() ||
    user?.faculty_name ||
    user?.username ||
    '';

  const employeeId = user?.faculty_id || user?.username || '';
  const schoolName = user?.school_name || 'Department of Education';

  const loadDashboardData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get('/api/classroom/roster/');
      setSections(res.data || []);
      setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
    } catch {
      // Keep existing data on temporary network blips
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const checkOfflineStorage = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const count = await getUnsyncedCount();
      setOfflineCount(count);
    } catch {
      // Ignore background storage check error
    }
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    await Promise.all([loadDashboardData(), checkOfflineStorage(), refreshUser()]);
    setRefreshing(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboardData();
    checkOfflineStorage();
    refreshUser();
  }, [loadDashboardData, checkOfflineStorage, refreshUser]);

  // Computed live metrics
  const totalClasses = sections.length;
  const totalStudentsEnrolled = sections.reduce((acc, s) => acc + (s.students?.length || 0), 0);
  const totalPresent = sections.reduce(
    (acc, s) => acc + (s.students?.filter((st) => st.attendance_status === 'PRESENT').length || 0),
    0
  );
  const totalLate = sections.reduce(
    (acc, s) => acc + (s.students?.filter((st) => st.attendance_status === 'LATE').length || 0),
    0
  );
  const totalUnscanned = sections.reduce(
    (acc, s) => acc + (s.students?.filter((st) => st.attendance_status === 'UNSCANNED').length || 0),
    0
  );

  const overallRate =
    totalStudentsEnrolled > 0
      ? Math.round(((totalPresent + totalLate) / totalStudentsEnrolled) * 100)
      : 0;

  const handleVerifyLocation = async () => {
    setTelemetryLoading(true);
    try {
      const deviceId = user?.faculty_id || user?.username || 'FACULTY-DEVICE';
      const result: any = await sendLiveHeartbeat(deviceId);

      if (result.isQueuedOffline) {
        Alert.alert('Offline Mode', 'No network connection. Telemetry ping saved to device.');
      } else {
        setIsInsideGeofence(result?.is_inside_perimeter ?? true);
        setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
        Alert.alert('Presence Verified', 'Your location has been logged for Civil Service Form 48.');
      }
      await checkOfflineStorage();
    } catch (err: any) {
      Alert.alert('Location Error', err?.message || 'Unable to get GPS coordinates.');
    } finally {
      setTelemetryLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safeContainer} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" backgroundColor="#ffffff" />

      {/* Top Header */}
      <View style={styles.topHeader}>
        <View style={styles.brandGroup}>
          <Image source={schoolLogo} style={styles.schoolLogo} contentFit="contain" />
          <View style={styles.brandTextGroup}>
            <Text style={styles.schoolTitle} numberOfLines={1}>{schoolName}</Text>
            <View style={styles.subBrandRow}>
              <View style={styles.activeDot} />
              <Text style={styles.protocolText}>ATTENDSURE PRESENCE GATEWAY</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.refreshButton}
          onPress={onRefresh}
          activeOpacity={0.7}
        >
          <Ionicons name="refresh" size={18} color="#004b87" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        style={styles.scrollArea}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        refreshControl={<RefreshControl refreshing={refreshing} onRefresh={onRefresh} colors={[COLORS.primary]} />}
      >
        {/* 1. Duty Banner */}
        <View style={styles.dutyCard}>
          <View style={styles.dutyTopRow}>
            <View style={styles.dutyUserMeta}>
              <Text style={styles.welcomeGreeting}>Welcome back,</Text>
              <Text style={styles.facultyDisplayName} numberOfLines={1}>
                {displayName}
              </Text>
              {employeeId ? (
                <Text style={styles.empIdBadgeText}>Employee ID: {employeeId}</Text>
              ) : null}
            </View>

            <View style={styles.dutyBadge}>
              <Ionicons name="shield-checkmark" size={14} color="#004b87" />
              <Text style={styles.dutyBadgeText}>ACTIVE ON DUTY</Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.dutyDivider} />

          <View style={styles.telemetryStatusRow}>
            <View style={styles.perimeterChip}>
              <Ionicons
                name={isInsideGeofence ? 'radio' : 'alert-circle'}
                size={14}
                color={isInsideGeofence ? '#059669' : '#d97706'}
              />
              <Text
                style={[
                  styles.perimeterChipText,
                  { color: isInsideGeofence ? '#059669' : '#d97706' },
                ]}
              >
                {isInsideGeofence ? 'Within Campus Boundary' : 'Outside Campus Boundary'}
              </Text>
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.pingButton, telemetryLoading && styles.btnDisabled]}
              onPress={handleVerifyLocation}
              disabled={telemetryLoading}
              activeOpacity={0.8}
            >
              {telemetryLoading ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#ffffff" />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Ionicons name="navigate" size={13} color="#ffffff" />
                  <Text style={styles.pingButtonText}>Verify Presence</Text>
                </>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* 2. Offline Notice */}
        {offlineCount > 0 && (
          <View style={styles.offlineWarningBanner}>
            <Ionicons name="cloud-offline" size={16} color="#b45309" />
            <Text style={styles.offlineWarningText}>
              {offlineCount} scan(s) stored on your phone. Upload them in the Settings tab.
            </Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* 3. Daily Classroom Analytics */}
        <View style={styles.sectionHeadingRow}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionHeadingTitle}>Daily Classroom Analytics</Text>
          {lastSyncTime ? (
            <Text style={styles.syncTimestampText}>Synced {lastSyncTime}</Text>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        <View style={styles.overallRateCard}>
          <View style={styles.rateHeaderRow}>
            <View>
              <Text style={styles.rateCardTitle}>Overall Class Attendance</Text>
              <Text style={styles.rateCardSub}>
                {totalPresent + totalLate} of {totalStudentsEnrolled} learners scanned today
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.rateBigText}>{overallRate}%</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.overallProgressTrack}>
            <View style={[styles.overallProgressFill, { width: `${Math.min(overallRate, 100)}%` }]} />
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.kpiGrid}>
          <View style={styles.kpiTile}>
            <View style={[styles.kpiIconWrap, { backgroundColor: '#e0f2fe' }]}>
              <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={16} color="#0284c7" />
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.kpiValue}>{totalClasses}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.kpiLabel}>Classes</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.kpiTile}>
            <View style={[styles.kpiIconWrap, { backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9' }]}>
              <Ionicons name="people-outline" size={16} color="#475569" />
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.kpiValue}>{totalStudentsEnrolled}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.kpiLabel}>Learners</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.kpiTile}>
            <View style={[styles.kpiIconWrap, { backgroundColor: '#dcfce7' }]}>
              <Ionicons name="checkmark-done-outline" size={16} color="#16a34a" />
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.kpiValue, { color: '#16a34a' }]}>{totalPresent}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.kpiLabel}>Present</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.kpiTile}>
            <View style={[styles.kpiIconWrap, { backgroundColor: '#fef3c7' }]}>
              <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={16} color="#d97706" />
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.kpiValue, { color: '#d97706' }]}>{totalLate}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.kpiLabel}>Tardy</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* 4. Assigned Class Sessions */}
        <View style={styles.sectionHeadingRow}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionHeadingTitle}>Assigned Class Sessions</Text>
          <Text style={styles.classCountText}>{sections.length} Active</Text>
        </View>

        {loading ? (
          <View style={styles.loadingCard}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#004b87" />
            <Text style={styles.loadingCardText}>Loading class schedules...</Text>
          </View>
        ) : sections.length === 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.emptyClassCard}>
            <Ionicons name="school-outline" size={38} color="#94a3b8" />
            <Text style={styles.emptyClassTitle}>No Classes Assigned Today</Text>

        ) : (
          sections.map((sec, index) => {

            const classRate =
              sec.total_students > 0
                ? Math.round(((classPresent + classLate) / sec.total_students) * 100)
                : 0;

            return (

        )}
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );

// mobile/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StyleSheet,
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  StatusBar,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { ServerConfigModal } from '../components/ServerConfigModal';
import { getDeviceHardwareInfo } from '../services/deviceService';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/theme';

const defaultSchoolLogo = require('../../assets/logo.svg');

interface SchoolMetadata {
  schoolName: string;
  divisionLabel: string;
  logoUrl: string | null;
}

export const LoginScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { login } = useAuth();

  // Form State
  const [username, setUsername] = useState<string>('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState<string>('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [configVisible, setConfigVisible] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Focus Highlight States
  const [userFocused, setUserFocused] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [passFocused, setPassFocused] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Dynamic Telemetry & School Branding
  const [deviceModel, setDeviceModel] = useState<string>('');
  const [hardwareId, setHardwareId] = useState<string>('');
  const [schoolData, setSchoolData] = useState<SchoolMetadata>({
    schoolName: '',
    divisionLabel: '',
    logoUrl: null,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    const bootstrapTelemetryAndBranding = async () => {
      try {
        const hwInfo = await getDeviceHardwareInfo();
        if (isMounted) {
          const displayModel =
            hwInfo.brand && hwInfo.device_model
              ? `${hwInfo.brand} ${hwInfo.device_model}`
              : hwInfo.device_model || '';
          setDeviceModel(displayModel);
          setHardwareId(hwInfo.client_device_id || '');
        }
      } catch {
        if (isMounted) {
          setDeviceModel('');
          setHardwareId('');
        }
      }

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get('/api/settings/school/');
        if (isMounted && res.data) {
          const name = res.data.school_name || '';
          const division = res.data.division ? `Division of ${res.data.division}` : '';
          const region = res.data.region ? `Region ${res.data.region}` : '';
          const divisionLabel = [division, region].filter(Boolean).join(' • ');

          setSchoolData({
            schoolName: name,
            divisionLabel: divisionLabel,
            logoUrl: res.data.school_logo || null,
          });
        }
      } catch {
        // Keeps state clean when server has not provided school data yet
      }
    };

    bootstrapTelemetryAndBranding();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const handleLogin = async () => {
    const cleanUser = username.trim();
    const cleanPass = password.trim();

    if (!cleanUser || !cleanPass) {
      Alert.alert(
        'Missing Credentials',
        'Please enter your Employee ID / Username and Password.'
      );
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // Must succeed against the Django database to unlock navigation
      await login(cleanUser, cleanPass);
    } catch (err: any) {
      let serverMessage = 'Invalid credentials. Only registered users in the database can sign in.';

      if (err?.response?.data) {
        serverMessage =
          err.response.data.error ||
          err.response.data.detail ||
          err.response.data.non_field_errors?.[0] ||
          serverMessage;
      } else if (err?.message && !err?.response) {
        serverMessage = 'Cannot connect to backend server. Please verify your host IP address.';
      }

      setPassword('');
      Alert.alert('Authentication Denied', serverMessage);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safeContainer} edges={['top', 'left', 'right', 'bottom']}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" backgroundColor="#f8fafc" />

      {/* Top Header Navigation */}
      <View style={styles.topHeader}>
        <View style={styles.gatewayBadge}>
          <View style={styles.statusDot} />
          <Text style={styles.gatewayText}>DEPED TELEMETRY PROTOCOL</Text>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.settingsBtn}
          onPress={() => setConfigVisible(true)}
          accessibilityLabel="Open Server Host Settings"
          activeOpacity={0.7}
        >
          <Ionicons name="server-outline" size={18} color="#475569" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={styles.keyboardContainer}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView
          contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        >
          {/* Institutional Crest & App Identity */}
          <View style={styles.brandContainer}>
            <View style={styles.crestCircle}>
              <Image
                source={schoolData.logoUrl ? { uri: schoolData.logoUrl } : defaultSchoolLogo}
                style={styles.crestImage}
                contentFit="contain"
                transition={200}
              />
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.mainTitle}>AttendSure</Text>
            {schoolData.schoolName ? (
              <Text style={styles.schoolTitle}>{schoolData.schoolName}</Text>
            ) : null}
            {schoolData.divisionLabel ? (
              <Text style={styles.divisionSubtitle}>{schoolData.divisionLabel}</Text>
            ) : null}
          </View>

          {/* Hardware Device Authorization Card */}
          <View style={styles.hardwareCard}>
            <View style={styles.hardwareCardHeader}>
              <View style={styles.hwIconTitle}>
                <Ionicons name="shield-checkmark" size={16} color={COLORS.accent} />
                <Text style={styles.hwTitleText}>DEVICE AUTHORIZATION</Text>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.activeTag}>
                <Text style={styles.activeTagText}>ACTIVE</Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            {deviceModel ? (
              <View style={styles.hwDetailRow}>
                <Text style={styles.hwLabel}>Hardware Model:</Text>
                <Text style={styles.hwVal}>{deviceModel}</Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            {hardwareId ? (
              <View style={styles.hwDetailRow}>
                <Text style={styles.hwLabel}>Hardware UUID:</Text>
                <Text style={styles.hwValMono} numberOfLines={1} ellipsizeMode="middle">
                  {hardwareId}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            <Text style={styles.hwDisclaimer}>
              Only database-registered personnel can bind this smartphone to official Civil Service records.
            </Text>
          </View>

          {/* Login Card */}
          <View style={styles.loginCard}>
            <Text style={styles.cardHeaderLabel}>DATABASE CREDENTIALS</Text>

            {/* Username / Employee ID */}
            <View style={styles.fieldGroup}>
              <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Employee ID or Username</Text>
              <View style={[styles.inputBox, userFocused && styles.inputBoxFocused]}>
                <Ionicons
                  name="person-outline"
                  size={18}
                  color={userFocused ? COLORS.primary : '#94a3b8'}
                  style={styles.inputLeadingIcon}
                />
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="Enter registered ID or username"
                  placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
                  value={username}
                  onChangeText={setUsername}
                  onFocus={() => setUserFocused(true)}
                  onBlur={() => setUserFocused(false)}
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  autoCorrect={false}
                  autoComplete="username"
                  textContentType="username"
                />
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* Password Field */}
            <View style={styles.fieldGroup}>
              <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Password</Text>
              <View style={[styles.inputBox, passFocused && styles.inputBoxFocused]}>
                <Ionicons
                  name="lock-closed-outline"
                  size={18}
                  color={passFocused ? COLORS.primary : '#94a3b8'}
                  style={styles.inputLeadingIcon}
                />
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="Enter database password"
                  placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
                  value={password}
                  onChangeText={setPassword}
                  onFocus={() => setPassFocused(true)}
                  onBlur={() => setPassFocused(false)}
                  secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  textContentType="password"
                />
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                  style={styles.eyeBtn}
                  activeOpacity={0.7}
                  accessibilityLabel="Toggle password visibility"
                >
                  <Ionicons
                    name={showPassword ? 'eye-off-outline' : 'eye-outline'}
                    size={20}
                    color="#64748b"
                  />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* Sign In CTA */}
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.loginBtn, loading && styles.btnDisabled]}
              onPress={handleLogin}
              disabled={loading}
              activeOpacity={0.88}
            >
              {loading ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color="#ffffff" size="small" />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Text style={styles.loginBtnText}>Verify & Authorize Account</Text>
                  <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={17} color="#ffffff" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }} />
                </>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          {/* Compliance Footnote */}
          <View style={styles.complianceFooter}>
            <Text style={styles.footerBrand}>ATTENDSURE INTEGRATED SYSTEM</Text>
            <Text style={styles.footerNote}>
              Civil Service Commission Form 48 Standards • Strict Server-Side Authentication
            </Text>
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>

      {/* Network Host Settings Modal */}
      <ServerConfigModal visible={configVisible} onClose={() => setConfigVisible(false)} />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

// mobile/src/screens/ProfileSettingsScreen.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ScrollView,
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  StatusBar,
  Modal,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import QRCode from 'react-native-qrcode-svg';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';

export const ProfileSettingsScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { user, logout, deviceIdentity, updateUser } = useAuth();

  const [firstName, setFirstName] = useState<string>('');
  const [lastName, setLastName] = useState<string>('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState<string>('');
  const [contactNumber, setContactNumber] = useState<string>('');
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState<string>('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState<string>('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [qrPassVisible, setQrPassVisible] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const displayName =
    `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim() ||
    user?.full_name ||
    user?.faculty_name ||
    user?.username ||
    '';

  const employeeId = user?.faculty_id || user?.username || '';
  const roleName = user?.role || (user?.is_superuser ? 'ADMIN' : 'FACULTY');
  const qrValue = user?.qr_token || user?.faculty_id || user?.username || '';
  const hardwareUuid = deviceIdentity?.deviceId || user?.bound_device_id || '';
  const schoolName = user?.school_name || 'Department of Education';
  const division = user?.division || 'Schools Division Office';
  const department = user?.department || 'Faculty Department';

  const loadProfile = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get('/api/me/');
      const data = res.data;
      if (data) {
        setFirstName(data.first_name || '');
        setLastName(data.last_name || '');
        setEmail(data.email || '');
        setContactNumber(data.contact_number || '');
      }
    } catch {
      if (user) {
        setFirstName(user.first_name || '');
        setLastName(user.last_name || '');
        setEmail(user.email || '');
        setContactNumber(user.contact_number || '');
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProfile();
  }, [loadProfile]);

  const handleSaveProfile = async () => {
    if (!firstName.trim() || !lastName.trim()) {
      Alert.alert('Incomplete Name', 'First name and last name are required.');
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword && newPassword.length < 6) {
      Alert.alert('Weak Password', 'New password must have at least 6 characters.');
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword && newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      Alert.alert('Password Mismatch', 'Confirmation password does not match.');
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: any = {
        first_name: firstName.trim(),
        last_name: lastName.trim(),
        email: email.trim(),
        contact_number: contactNumber.trim(),
      };

      if (newPassword) {
        payload.password = newPassword.trim();
      }

      const res = await apiClient.put('/api/me/', payload);
      const data = res.data;

      const fullName = `${data.first_name || firstName.trim()} ${data.last_name || lastName.trim()}`.trim();
      await updateUser({
        first_name: data.first_name || firstName.trim(),
        last_name: data.last_name || lastName.trim(),
        full_name: fullName,
        faculty_name: fullName,
        email: data.email || email.trim(),
        contact_number: data.contact_number || contactNumber.trim(),
      });

      setNewPassword('');
      setConfirmPassword('');
      Alert.alert('Profile Saved', 'Your personal credentials were saved successfully.');
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.error || 'Unable to update profile. Check your connection.';
      Alert.alert('Save Failed', msg);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const confirmSignOut = () => {
    Alert.alert(
      'Log Out Account',
      'Are you sure you want to sign out from this smartphone?',
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        { text: 'Log Out', style: 'destructive', onPress: logout },
      ]
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" backgroundColor="#ffffff" />

      <View style={styles.topHeader}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.backButton}
          onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
          activeOpacity={0.7}
        >
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color="#003460" />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
          <Text style={styles.screenTitle}>Faculty Profile</Text>
          <Text style={styles.screenSub}>Civil Service Credentials & Settings</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.headerBadge}>
          <View style={styles.activeDot} />
          <Text style={styles.headerBadgeText}>DEPED CSC</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {/* 1. Identity Card */}
        <View style={styles.identityCard}>
          <View style={styles.identityRow}>
            <View style={styles.avatarCircle}>
              <Text style={styles.avatarInitial}>{displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</Text>
            </View>

            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 14 }}>
              <Text style={styles.facultyNameText} numberOfLines={1}>
                {displayName}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.facultyRoleText}>
                {roleName} • {department}
              </Text>
              {employeeId ? (
                <Text style={styles.employeeIdText}>Employee ID: {employeeId}</Text>
              ) : null}
            </View>
          </View>

          {qrValue ? (
            <>
              <View style={styles.cardDivider} />
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.gatePassLauncherBtn}
                onPress={() => setQrPassVisible(true)}
                activeOpacity={0.8}
              >
                <Ionicons name="qr-code" size={17} color="#004b87" />
                <Text style={styles.gatePassLauncherBtnText}>Show Turnstile Optical Pass</Text>
                <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={15} color="#004b87" style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* 2. Personal Credentials */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.cardHeaderRow}>
            <Ionicons name="create-outline" size={17} color="#004b87" />
            <Text style={styles.cardHeaderTitle}>PERSONAL CREDENTIALS</Text>
          </View>

          {loading ? (
            <View style={styles.loadingInner}>
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#004b87" />
              <Text style={styles.loadingInnerText}>Loading faculty record...</Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <>
              <View style={styles.fieldGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>First Name</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  value={firstName}
                  onChangeText={setFirstName}
                  placeholder="Enter first name"
                  placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.fieldGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Last Name</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  value={lastName}
                  onChangeText={setLastName}
                  placeholder="Enter last name"
                  placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.fieldGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Official Email Address</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  value={email}
                  onChangeText={setEmail}
                  placeholder="faculty@deped.gov.ph"
                  placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
                  keyboardType="email-address"
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.fieldGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Mobile Phone Number</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  value={contactNumber}
                  onChangeText={setContactNumber}
                  placeholder="09171234567"
                  placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
                  keyboardType="phone-pad"
                />
              </View>
            </>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* 3. Password Security */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.cardHeaderRow}>
            <Ionicons name="lock-closed-outline" size={17} color="#004b87" />
            <Text style={styles.cardHeaderTitle}>SECURITY & PASSWORD</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.fieldGroup}>
            <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>New Password (leave blank to keep current)</Text>
            <View style={styles.passwordInputWrap}>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.passwordInput}
                value={newPassword}
                onChangeText={setNewPassword}
                placeholder="Minimum 6 characters"
                placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
                secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
                autoCapitalize="none"
              />
              <TouchableOpacity
                onPress={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                style={styles.eyeBtn}
              >
                <Ionicons
                  name={showPassword ? 'eye-off-outline' : 'eye-outline'}
                  size={18}
                  color="#64748b"
                />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>

          {newPassword.length > 0 && (
            <View style={styles.fieldGroup}>
              <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Confirm New Password</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.textInput}
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChangeText={setConfirmPassword}
                placeholder="Re-type new password"
                placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
                secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
                autoCapitalize="none"
              />
            </View>
          )}

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.saveBtn, saving && styles.btnDisabled]}
            onPress={handleSaveProfile}
            disabled={saving}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
          >
            {saving ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#ffffff" />
            ) : (
              <>
                <Ionicons name="save-outline" size={16} color="#ffffff" style={{ marginRight: 6 }} />
                <Text style={styles.saveBtnText}>Save Profile Changes</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* 4. Institutional Information */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.cardHeaderRow}>
            <Ionicons name="hardware-chip-outline" size={17} color="#004b87" />
            <Text style={styles.cardHeaderTitle}>INSTITUTION & DEVICE</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.infoRow}>
            <Text style={styles.infoLabel}>School:</Text>
            <Text style={styles.infoValue}>{schoolName}</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.infoRow}>
            <Text style={styles.infoLabel}>Division:</Text>
            <Text style={styles.infoValue}>{division}</Text>
          </View>

          {hardwareUuid ? (
            <View style={styles.infoRow}>
              <Text style={styles.infoLabel}>Bound Hardware:</Text>
              <Text style={styles.infoValueMono} numberOfLines={1} ellipsizeMode="middle">
                {hardwareUuid}
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* 5. Log Out */}
        <View style={[styles.card, { backgroundColor: '#fffafa', borderColor: '#fecaca' }]}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.logoutBtn} onPress={confirmSignOut} activeOpacity={0.8}>
            <Ionicons name="log-out-outline" size={18} color="#dc2626" />
            <Text style={styles.logoutBtnText}>Log Out from this Device</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Gate Pass Modal */}
      <Modal visible={qrPassVisible} animationType="fade" transparent>
        <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.qrSheet}>
            <View style={styles.qrSheetHeader}>
              <View>
                <Text style={styles.qrSheetTitle}>Civil Service Form 48 Pass</Text>
                <Text style={styles.qrSheetSub}>Turnstile Scanner Barcode</Text>
              </View>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setQrPassVisible(false)}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color="#64748b" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.qrContainer}>
              <QRCode value={qrValue || 'UNSET'} size={180} color="#0f172a" backgroundColor="#ffffff" />
            </View>

            <View style={styles.qrMetaBox}>
              <Text style={styles.qrMetaLabel}>EMPLOYEE IDENTIFIER</Text>
              <Text style={styles.qrMetaValue}>{employeeId}</Text>
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.qrCloseBtn} onPress={() => setQrPassVisible(false)}>
              <Text style={styles.qrCloseBtnText}>Close Pass</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },

  cardHeaderTitle: { fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '800', color: '#004b87', letterSpacing: 0.5 },
  loadingInner: { alignItems: 'center', paddingVertical: 16 },
  loadingInnerText: { fontSize: 11.5, color: '#64748b', marginTop: 6 },

  fieldLabel: { fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '700', color: '#475569', marginBottom: 5 },

  passwordInput: { flex: 1, fontSize: 13, color: '#0f172a' },
  eyeBtn: { padding: 4 },

  saveBtnText: { color: '#ffffff', fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: '700' },
  btnDisabled: { opacity: 0.65 },
  infoRow: { flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingVertical: 5, borderBottomWidth: 1, borderBottomColor: '#f8fafc' },
  infoLabel: { fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b' },
  infoValue: { fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '700', color: '#0f172a', textAlign: 'right', flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 },
  infoValueMono: { fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '700', color: '#004b87', fontFamily: Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'Courier' : 'monospace', textAlign: 'right', flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 },
  logoutBtn: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', paddingVertical: 4, gap: 6 },
  logoutBtnText: { fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700', color: '#dc2626' },
  modalOverlay: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65)', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 20 },
  qrSheet: { width: '100%', backgroundColor: '#ffffff', borderRadius: 20, padding: 20, alignItems: 'center' },
  qrSheetHeader: { width: '100%', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 16 },
  qrSheetTitle: { fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '800', color: '#0f172a' },
  qrSheetSub: { fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b' },
  qrContainer: { padding: 16, backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', borderRadius: 14, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#e2e8f0' },
  qrMetaBox: { alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 14, backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9', paddingVertical: 6, paddingHorizontal: 16, borderRadius: 10 },
  qrMetaLabel: { fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: '800', color: '#64748b' },
  qrMetaValue: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800', color: '#004b87', marginTop: 1 },
  qrCloseBtn: { width: '100%', backgroundColor: '#004b87', paddingVertical: 10, borderRadius: 10, alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 16 },

================================================================================
FILE: .\mobile\src\screens\ScannerScreen.tsx
