import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Modal,
  Vibration,
  TextInput,
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  FlatList,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions } from 'expo-camera';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/theme';
import {
  playScanSuccessSound,
  playScanWarningSound,
  playScanErrorSound,
} from '../services/soundService';

interface StudentRosterItem {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  qr_token: string;
  full_name: string;
  gender?: string;
  attendance_status: 'PRESENT' | 'LATE' | 'CUTTING' | 'UNVERIFIED' | 'UNSCANNED' | string;
}

interface SectionRoster {
  schedule_id: number;
  section_id: number;
  section_name: string;
  subject_name: string;
  subject_code: string;
  room: string;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
  total_students: number;
  students: StudentRosterItem[];
}

interface ScanResultData {
  name: string;
  lrn: string;
  section: string;
  status: string;
  is_anomaly: boolean;
  remarks: string;
  scan_time: string;
}

export const ScannerScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  // Camera State
  const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions();
  const [facing, setFacing] = useState<'back' | 'front'>('back');
  const [isScanningLocked, setIsScanningLocked] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Time & Ingestion Mode
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<string>('');
  const [currentDate, setCurrentDate] = useState<string>('');
  const [scanMode, setScanMode] = useState<'PRESENT' | 'LATE'>('PRESENT');
  const [vibrateEnabled, setVibrateEnabled] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Faculty Roster Data
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionRoster[]>([]);
  const [activeSectionIndex, setActiveSectionIndex] = useState<number>(0);
  const [rosterLoading, setRosterLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showRosterDrawer, setShowRosterDrawer] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showSectionPicker, setShowSectionPicker] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Verification & Manual Input
  const [manualInputVisible, setManualInputVisible] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [manualCode, setManualCode] = useState<string>('');
  const [scanLoading, setScanLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [modalVisible, setModalVisible] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastScannedStudent, setLastScannedStudent] = useState<ScanResultData | null>(null);

  const lockTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  // 1. Live Clock
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => {
      const now = new Date();
      setCurrentTime(
        now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' })
      );
      setCurrentDate(
        now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })
      );
    };
    update();
    const interval = setInterval(update, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  // 2. Load Persisted Audio & Haptic Preferences
  useEffect(() => {
    const loadPreferences = async () => {
      try {
        const storedSound = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pref_sound_enabled');
        const storedHaptic = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pref_haptic_enabled');
        if (storedSound !== null) setSoundEnabled(storedSound === 'true');
        if (storedHaptic !== null) setVibrateEnabled(storedHaptic === 'true');
      } catch {
        // Fall back to default enabled
      }
    };
    loadPreferences();
  }, []);

  const toggleSound = async () => {
    const nextVal = !soundEnabled;
    setSoundEnabled(nextVal);
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem('pref_sound_enabled', String(nextVal));
    } catch {
      // Storage error ignored
    }
  };

  // 3. Fetch Assigned Class Rosters
  const fetchFacultyRoster = useCallback(async () => {
    setRosterLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get('/api/classroom/roster/');
      const data: SectionRoster[] = res.data || [];
      setSections(data);
      if (data.length > 0 && activeSectionIndex >= data.length) {
        setActiveSectionIndex(0);
      }
    } catch {
      Alert.alert('Roster Sync Notice', 'Unable to fetch assigned classroom sections from server.');
    } finally {
      setRosterLoading(false);
    }
  }, [activeSectionIndex]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFacultyRoster();
  }, [fetchFacultyRoster]);

  const activeSection = sections[activeSectionIndex] || null;

  const unlockScanningDebounce = () => {
    if (lockTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(lockTimerRef.current);
    lockTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsScanningLocked(false);
    }, 1500);
  };

  // 4. Reject Faculty Identifiers (Prevents proxy/self scans)
  const isFacultyIdentifier = (code: string): boolean => {
    const clean = code.trim().toLowerCase();
    const myEmpId = (user?.faculty_id || (user as any)?.employee_id || '').toLowerCase();
    const myUsername = (user?.username || '').toLowerCase();
    const myQrToken = (user?.qr_token || '').toLowerCase();

    if (myEmpId && clean === myEmpId) return true;
    if (myUsername && clean === myUsername) return true;
    if (myQrToken && clean === myQrToken) return true;

    return clean.startsWith('emp-') || clean.startsWith('fac-') || clean.startsWith('employee-');
  };

  // 5. Verification & Batch Ingestion
  const processStudentScan = async (rawCode: string) => {
    const cleanCode = rawCode.trim();
    if (!cleanCode) return;

    if (!activeSection) {
      if (soundEnabled) await playScanErrorSound();
      Alert.alert('No Class Available', 'You do not have any teaching sections assigned to your faculty profile.');
      return;
    }

    // Shield: Reject Faculty Badges
    if (isFacultyIdentifier(cleanCode)) {
      if (soundEnabled) await playScanErrorSound();
      if (vibrateEnabled) Vibration.vibrate([0, 150, 100, 150]);
      Alert.alert('Faculty Pass Detected', 'Faculty identification cards cannot be used for student attendance logs.', [
        { text: 'OK', onPress: unlockScanningDebounce },
      ]);
      return;
    }

    // Section Whitelist Verification
    const enrolledMatch = activeSection.students.find(
      (s) =>
        s.lrn.toLowerCase() === cleanCode.toLowerCase() ||
        (s.qr_token && s.qr_token.toLowerCase() === cleanCode.toLowerCase())
    );

    if (!enrolledMatch) {
      if (soundEnabled) await playScanErrorSound();
      if (vibrateEnabled) Vibration.vibrate([0, 150, 100, 150]);
      Alert.alert(
        'Student Not in Class',
        `This learner is not registered in ${activeSection.section_name}. Please switch to their assigned class section.`,
        [{ text: 'OK', onPress: unlockScanningDebounce }]
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsScanningLocked(true);
    setScanLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/api/classroom/batch-scan/', {
        schedule_id: activeSection.schedule_id,
        scans: [{ qr_token: cleanCode, status: scanMode }],
      });

      const processed = res.data?.processed_records?.[0];
      const isAnomaly = Boolean(processed?.is_anomaly);
      const resultingStatus = processed?.status || scanMode;

      // Auditory & Haptic Feedback
      if (isAnomaly) {
        if (soundEnabled) await playScanWarningSound();
        if (vibrateEnabled) Vibration.vibrate([0, 200, 100, 200]);
      } else {
        if (soundEnabled) await playScanSuccessSound();
        if (vibrateEnabled) Vibration.vibrate(80);
      }

      // Live Section State Synchronization
      setSections((prev) =>
        prev.map((sec, idx) => {
          if (idx !== activeSectionIndex) return sec;
          return {
            ...sec,
            students: sec.students.map((st) =>
              st.id === enrolledMatch.id ? { ...st, attendance_status: resultingStatus } : st
            ),
          };
        })
      );

      setLastScannedStudent({
        name: enrolledMatch.full_name,
        lrn: enrolledMatch.lrn,
        section: activeSection.section_name,
        status: resultingStatus,
        is_anomaly: isAnomaly,
        remarks: processed?.remarks || 'Attendance scan recorded successfully.',
        scan_time: processed?.scan_time || currentTime || new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
      });

      setModalVisible(true);
      setManualInputVisible(false);
      setManualCode('');
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (soundEnabled) await playScanErrorSound();
      if (vibrateEnabled) Vibration.vibrate([0, 100, 100, 100]);
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.error || err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Unable to verify student attendance.';
      Alert.alert('Scan Incomplete', msg, [{ text: 'Continue', onPress: unlockScanningDebounce }]);
    } finally {
      setScanLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Dynamic Counter Calculations
  const presentCount = activeSection?.students.filter((s) => s.attendance_status === 'PRESENT').length || 0;
  const lateCount = activeSection?.students.filter((s) => s.attendance_status === 'LATE').length || 0;
  const anomalyCount =
    activeSection?.students.filter(
      (s) => s.attendance_status === 'UNVERIFIED' || s.attendance_status === 'CUTTING'
    ).length || 0;
  const unscannedCount = activeSection?.students.filter((s) => s.attendance_status === 'UNSCANNED').length || 0;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      {/* 1. Terminal Clock Header */}
      <View style={styles.clockCard}>
        <View style={styles.terminalIndicator}>
          <View style={styles.greenDot} />
          <Text style={styles.terminalIndicatorText}>FACULTY CLASSROOM SCANNER</Text>
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.clockDigits}>{currentTime || '--:--:--'}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.clockDate}>{currentDate}</Text>
      </View>

      {/* 2. Assigned Class Selector Banner */}
      {rosterLoading ? (
        <View style={styles.loadingBanner}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.primary} />
          <Text style={styles.loadingBannerText}>Synchronizing assigned teaching rosters...</Text>
        </View>
      ) : activeSection ? (
        <View style={styles.sectionHeaderBox}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={{ flex: 1 }}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            onPress={() => sections.length > 1 && setShowSectionPicker(true)}
          >
            <Text style={styles.sectionMetaTag}>ASSIGNED TEACHING SESSION</Text>
            <Text style={styles.activeSectionTitle} numberOfLines={1}>
              {`${activeSection.subject_name} • ${activeSection.section_name}`}
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.sectionSubDetails}>
              {activeSection.room} ({activeSection.start_time} - {activeSection.end_time})
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <View style={styles.sectionActionsRow}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.refreshIconBtn}
              onPress={fetchFacultyRoster}
              accessibilityLabel="Reload Roster"
            >
              <Ionicons name="refresh" size={15} color={COLORS.primary} />
            </TouchableOpacity>

            {sections.length > 1 && (
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.switchSectionBtn}
                onPress={() => setShowSectionPicker(true)}
              >
                <Ionicons name="swap-horizontal" size={14} color={COLORS.primary} />
                <Text style={styles.switchSectionBtnText}>Change</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.emptySectionBanner}>
          <Ionicons name="information-circle-outline" size={20} color="#b45309" />
          <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 8 }}>
            <Text style={styles.emptySectionTitle}>No Teaching Classes Assigned</Text>
            <Text style={styles.emptySectionSub}>
              Your faculty profile does not have any active class schedules or advisory sections assigned.
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* 3. Section Counter Chips */}
      <View style={styles.counterRow}>
        <View style={[styles.counterBox, { backgroundColor: '#ecfdf5', borderColor: '#a7f3d0' }]}>
          <Text style={[styles.counterLabel, { color: '#059669' }]}>PRESENT</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.counterValue, { color: '#047857' }]}>{presentCount}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={[styles.counterBox, { backgroundColor: '#fffbeb', borderColor: '#fef3c7' }]}>
          <Text style={[styles.counterLabel, { color: '#d97706' }]}>LATE</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.counterValue, { color: '#b45309' }]}>{lateCount}</Text>
        </View>

        {anomalyCount > 0 && (
          <View style={[styles.counterBox, { backgroundColor: '#fef2f2', borderColor: '#fecaca' }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.counterLabel, { color: '#dc2626' }]}>FLAGGED</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.counterValue, { color: '#b91c1c' }]}>{anomalyCount}</Text>
          </View>
        )}

        <View style={[styles.counterBox, { backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9', borderColor: '#e2e8f0' }]}>
          <Text style={[styles.counterLabel, { color: '#64748b' }]}>UNSCANNED</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.counterValue, { color: '#334155' }]}>{unscannedCount}</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* 4. Scanning Camera Viewfinder */}
      <View style={styles.viewfinderContainer}>
        <View style={styles.cameraBox}>
          {!permission?.granted ? (
            <View style={styles.permissionBox}>
              <Ionicons name="camera-outline" size={32} color="#94a3b8" />
              <Text style={styles.permissionText}>Camera access is required to verify student optical codes</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.grantBtn} onPress={requestPermission}>
                <Text style={styles.grantBtnText}>Grant Camera Permission</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <>
              <CameraView
                style={styles.fullAbsoluteFill}
                facing={facing}
                barcodeScannerSettings={{ barcodeTypes: ['qr', 'code128', 'code39', 'ean13'] }}
                onBarcodeScanned={isScanningLocked || scanLoading ? undefined : ({ data }) => processStudentScan(data)}
              />

              <View style={[styles.bracket, styles.bracketTL]} />
              <View style={[styles.bracket, styles.bracketTR]} />
              <View style={[styles.bracket, styles.bracketBL]} />
              <View style={[styles.bracket, styles.bracketBR]} />

              {scanLoading ? (
                <View style={styles.loadingOverlay}>
                  <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#ffffff" />
                  <Text style={styles.loadingOverlayText}>Verifying student credentials...</Text>
                </View>
              ) : (
                <View style={styles.laserLine} />
              )}

              {/* Sound Feedback Toggle Button */}
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.soundToggleBtn}
                onPress={toggleSound}
                accessibilityLabel="Toggle Scanner Audio"
              >
                <Ionicons
                  name={soundEnabled ? 'volume-high' : 'volume-mute'}
                  size={16}
                  color={soundEnabled ? '#38bdf8' : '#94a3b8'}
                />
              </TouchableOpacity>

              {/* Camera Flip Button */}
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.cameraFlipBtn}
                onPress={() => setFacing((cur) => (cur === 'back' ? 'front' : 'back'))}
              >
                <Ionicons name="camera-reverse-outline" size={18} color="#ffffff" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </>
          )}
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.helperText}>
          Align student barcode within viewfinder
        </Text>
      </View>

      {/* 5. Utility Controls */}
      <View style={styles.utilityRow}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.rosterDrawerBtn, !activeSection && styles.btnDisabled]}
          disabled={!activeSection}
          onPress={() => setShowRosterDrawer(true)}
        >
          <Ionicons name="people-outline" size={16} color={COLORS.primary} />
          <Text style={styles.rosterDrawerBtnText}>Class Roster ({activeSection?.total_students || 0})</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.manualBtn, !activeSection && styles.btnDisabled]}
          disabled={!activeSection}
          onPress={() => setManualInputVisible(true)}
        >
          <Ionicons name="keypad-outline" size={16} color="#334155" />
          <Text style={styles.manualBtnText}>Manual LRN</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Section Switcher Modal */}
      <Modal visible={showSectionPicker} transparent animationType="fade">
        <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
          <View style={styles.pickerModalSheet}>
            <View style={styles.pickerHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.pickerTitle}>Select Teaching Class</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowSectionPicker(false)}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={20} color="#64748b" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <FlatList
              data={sections}
              keyExtractor={(item) => String(item.schedule_id || item.section_id)}
              renderItem={({ item, index }) => {
                const isSelected = index === activeSectionIndex;
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[styles.sectionOption, isSelected && styles.sectionOptionActive]}
                    onPress={() => {
                      setActiveSectionIndex(index);
                      setShowSectionPicker(false);
                    }}
                  >
                    <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                      <Text style={[styles.sectionOptionTitle, isSelected && { color: COLORS.primary }]}>
                        {item.subject_name} • {item.section_name}
                      </Text>
                      <Text style={styles.sectionOptionSub}>
                        {item.room} • {item.total_students} Enrolled Students
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                    {isSelected && <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary} />}
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              }}
            />
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Class Student Roster Modal */}
      <Modal visible={showRosterDrawer} animationType="slide">
        <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#ffffff' }}>
          <View style={styles.rosterModalHeader}>
            <View>
              <Text style={styles.rosterModalTitle}>{activeSection?.section_name} Students</Text>
              <Text style={styles.rosterModalSub}>Only enrolled students of this class are accepted</Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowRosterDrawer(false)} style={styles.closeBtn}>
              <Ionicons name="close" size={24} color="#64748b" />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <FlatList
            data={activeSection?.students || []}
            keyExtractor={(item) => String(item.id)}
            contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16 }}
            renderItem={({ item }) => {
              const isPresent = item.attendance_status === 'PRESENT';
              const isLate = item.attendance_status === 'LATE';
              const isFlagged = item.attendance_status === 'UNVERIFIED' || item.attendance_status === 'CUTTING';
              const isUnscanned = item.attendance_status === 'UNSCANNED';

              return (
                <View style={styles.studentRosterRow}>
                  <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <Text style={styles.studentRowName}>{item.full_name}</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.studentRowLrn}>LRN: {item.lrn}</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.statusPillSmall,
                      isPresent && { backgroundColor: '#ecfdf5' },
                      isLate && { backgroundColor: '#fffbeb' },
                      isFlagged && { backgroundColor: '#fef2f2' },
                      isUnscanned && { backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9' },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.statusPillSmallText,
                        isPresent && { color: '#059669' },
                        isLate && { color: '#d97706' },
                        isFlagged && { color: '#dc2626' },
                        isUnscanned && { color: '#64748b' },
                      ]}
                    >
                      {item.attendance_status}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                </View>
              );
            }}
          />
        </SafeAreaView>
      </Modal>

      {/* Manual LRN Dialog */}
      <Modal visible={manualInputVisible} transparent animationType="fade">
        <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
          <View style={styles.inputModalSheet}>
            <Text style={styles.inputModalTitle}>Enter Student LRN</Text>
            <Text style={styles.inputModalSub}>Records attendance directly into {activeSection?.section_name}.</Text>

            <TextInput
              style={styles.modalTextInput}
              placeholder="Enter 12-digit Learner Reference Number"
              placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
              value={manualCode}
              onChangeText={setManualCode}
              keyboardType="numeric"
              autoFocus
            />

            <View style={styles.modalActionsRow}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.cancelBtn}
                onPress={() => {
                  setManualInputVisible(false);
                  setManualCode('');
                }}
              >
                <Text style={styles.cancelBtnText}>Cancel</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.submitBtn}
                onPress={() => processStudentScan(manualCode)}
                disabled={scanLoading}
              >
                {scanLoading ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#ffffff" />
                ) : (
                  <Text style={styles.submitBtnText}>Verify LRN</Text>
                )}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Verification Result Modal */}
      <Modal visible={modalVisible} transparent animationType="fade">
        <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
          <View style={styles.modalSheet}>
            <View style={styles.successHeadingGroup}>
              <Ionicons
                name={lastScannedStudent?.is_anomaly ? 'warning' : 'checkmark-circle'}
                size={24}
                color={lastScannedStudent?.is_anomaly ? '#d97706' : '#10b981'}
              />
              <Text style={[styles.modalHeadingText, lastScannedStudent?.is_anomaly && { color: '#b45309' }]}>
                {lastScannedStudent?.is_anomaly ? 'Attendance Anomaly' : `Logged in ${activeSection?.section_name}`}
              </Text>
            </View>

            <View style={[styles.studentAvatarRing, lastScannedStudent?.is_anomaly && { borderColor: '#d97706' }]}>
              <Ionicons name="person" size={40} color={lastScannedStudent?.is_anomaly ? '#d97706' : COLORS.primary} />
            </View>

            <Text style={styles.studentModalName}>{lastScannedStudent?.name}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.studentModalLrn}>LRN: {lastScannedStudent?.lrn}</Text>

            {lastScannedStudent?.is_anomaly && (
              <View style={styles.anomalyBanner}>
                <Ionicons name="shield-outline" size={16} color="#b45309" />
                <Text style={styles.anomalyBannerText}>{lastScannedStudent.remarks}</Text>
              </View>
            )}

            <View
              style={[
                styles.statusPillLarge,
                lastScannedStudent?.is_anomaly && { backgroundColor: '#fef3c7', borderColor: '#fde68a' },
              ]}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.statusPillTitle, lastScannedStudent?.is_anomaly && { color: '#92400e' }]}>
                {lastScannedStudent?.status}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.statusPillTime}>Recorded at {lastScannedStudent?.scan_time}</Text>
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.confirmModalBtn}
              onPress={() => {
                setModalVisible(false);
                unlockScanningDebounce();
              }}
            >
              <Text style={styles.confirmModalBtnText}>Continue Scanning</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

// mobile/src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  Switch,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ScrollView,
  Alert,
  ActivityIndicator,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { NativeStackNavigationProp } from '@react-navigation/native-stack';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { RootStackParamList } from '../navigation/AppNavigator';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { ServerConfigModal } from '../components/ServerConfigModal';
import { sendLiveHeartbeat } from '../services/telemetryService';
import { getUnsyncedCount, flushOfflineTelemetryQueue } from '../services/offlineQueue';

export const SettingsScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const navigation = useNavigation<NativeStackNavigationProp<RootStackParamList>>();
  const { user, logout, deviceIdentity, refreshUser } = useAuth();

  // Scanner Feedback Preferences (Dynamically loaded from storage)
  const [autoSms, setAutoSms] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [hapticEnabled, setHapticEnabled] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Telemetry & Queue State
  const [offlineCount, setOfflineCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [syncingOffline, setSyncingOffline] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [testingPing, setTestingPing] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Modal
  const [configVisible, setConfigVisible] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Dynamic Profile & Account Data
  const displayName =
    user?.full_name ||
    `${user?.first_name || ''} ${user?.last_name || ''}`.trim() ||
    user?.faculty_name ||
    user?.username ||
    '';

  const employeeId = user?.faculty_id || user?.username || '';
  const roleName = user?.role || (user?.is_superuser ? 'ADMIN' : 'FACULTY');
  const departmentName = user?.department || user?.school_name || '';
  const hardwareUuid = deviceIdentity?.deviceId || user?.bound_device_id || '';

  // 1. Load Persisted Switch Preferences
  useEffect(() => {
    const loadPreferences = async () => {
      try {
        const [savedAutoSms, savedSound, savedHaptic] = await Promise.all([
          AsyncStorage.getItem('pref_auto_sms'),
          AsyncStorage.getItem('pref_sound_enabled'),
          AsyncStorage.getItem('pref_haptic_enabled'),
        ]);

        if (savedAutoSms !== null) setAutoSms(savedAutoSms === 'true');
        if (savedSound !== null) setSoundEnabled(savedSound === 'true');
        if (savedHaptic !== null) setHapticEnabled(savedHaptic === 'true');
      } catch {
        // Retain current states on storage error
      }
    };

    loadPreferences();
    refreshUser?.();
  }, [refreshUser]);

  // Switch Toggles with Storage Persistence
  const toggleAutoSms = async (val: boolean) => {
    setAutoSms(val);
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem('pref_auto_sms', String(val));
    } catch {
      // Ignored
    }
  };

  const toggleSound = async (val: boolean) => {
    setSoundEnabled(val);
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem('pref_sound_enabled', String(val));
    } catch {
      // Ignored
    }
  };

  const toggleHaptic = async (val: boolean) => {
    setHapticEnabled(val);
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem('pref_haptic_enabled', String(val));
    } catch {
      // Ignored
    }
  };

  // 2. Check Pending Local Offline Queue
  const loadOfflineCount = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const count = await getUnsyncedCount();
      setOfflineCount(count);
    } catch {
      // Ignore background storage check error
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadOfflineCount();
  }, [loadOfflineCount]);

  const handleManualSync = async () => {
    if (offlineCount === 0) {
      Alert.alert('Queue Empty', 'All attendance logs and telemetry heartbeats are already uploaded.');
      return;
    }

    setSyncingOffline(true);
    try {
      const res = await flushOfflineTelemetryQueue();
      Alert.alert('Sync Successful', `Uploaded ${res.sent} pending log(s) to the server.`);
      await loadOfflineCount();
    } catch {
      Alert.alert('Sync Incomplete', 'Could not establish connection to the backend server.');
    } finally {
      setSyncingOffline(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTestGeofence = async () => {
    setTestingPing(true);
    try {
      const deviceId = employeeId || hardwareUuid || 'MOBILE-CLIENT';
      const result: any = await sendLiveHeartbeat(deviceId);

      if (result.isQueuedOffline) {
        Alert.alert('Offline Mode', 'Server unreachable. Telemetry heartbeat stored in local phone queue.');
      } else {
        const boundaryNotice = result?.is_inside_perimeter
          ? 'Device confirmed INSIDE campus geofence perimeter.'
          : 'Warning: Device is OUTSIDE designated campus perimeter.';
        Alert.alert('Geofence Audit', boundaryNotice);
      }
      await loadOfflineCount();
    } catch (err: any) {
      Alert.alert('Telemetry Check Failed', err?.message || 'Unable to obtain GPS coordinates.');
    } finally {
      setTestingPing(false);
    }
  };

  const confirmSignOut = () => {
    Alert.alert(
      'Log Out Account',
      'Are you sure you want to sign out? Your device credentials will be detached until next sign-in.',
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        { text: 'Log Out', style: 'destructive', onPress: logout },
      ]
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      {/* Top Header */}
      <View style={styles.topHeader}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Text style={styles.screenTitle}>Application Settings</Text>
          <Text style={styles.screenSub}>System Controls, Hardware Telemetry & Preferences</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.headerBadge}>
          <View style={styles.activeDot} />
          <Text style={styles.headerBadgeText}>SYSTEM CONFIG</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {/* 1. Faculty Profile Identity Card */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.card}
          activeOpacity={0.85}
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate('ProfileSettings')}
        >
          <View style={styles.cardHeaderRow}>
            <Ionicons name="person-circle-outline" size={18} color="#004b87" />
            <Text style={styles.cardHeaderTitle}>FACULTY PROFILE IDENTITY</Text>
            <View style={styles.editBadge}>
              <Text style={styles.editBadgeText}>Edit Profile</Text>
              <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={14} color="#004b87" />
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.profileRow}>
            <View style={styles.avatarCircle}>
              <Text style={styles.avatarInitial}>
                {displayName ? displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : '?'}
              </Text>
            </View>

            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
              <Text style={styles.profileName} numberOfLines={1}>
                {displayName || 'Authenticated Faculty'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.profileRole}>
                Role: {roleName}{departmentName ? ` • ${departmentName}` : ''}
              </Text>
              {employeeId ? (
                <Text style={styles.profileId}>Employee ID: {employeeId}</Text>
              ) : null}
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.tapToEditFooter}>
            <Text style={styles.tapToEditText}>Tap to edit credentials or view turnstile pass</Text>
          </View>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* 2. Scanner & Audio/Haptic Feedback */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.cardHeaderRow}>
            <Ionicons name="options-outline" size={18} color="#004b87" />
            <Text style={styles.cardHeaderTitle}>SCANNER FEEDBACK & DISPATCH</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.switchRow}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 10 }}>
              <Text style={styles.switchTitle}>Auto-SMS Parent Dispatch</Text>
              <Text style={styles.switchDetail}>Queue automatic SMS delivery to parents upon student scans</Text>
            </View>
            <Switch
              value={autoSms}
              onValueChange={toggleAutoSms}
              trackColor={{ false: '#cbd5e1', true: '#b8d6f0' }}
              thumbColor={autoSms ? '#004b87' : '#f8fafc'}
            />
          </View>

          <View style={styles.switchRow}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 10 }}>
              <Text style={styles.switchTitle}>Audible Scan Beep</Text>
              <Text style={styles.switchDetail}>Play standard audio chime on successful attendance ingestion</Text>
            </View>
            <Switch
              value={soundEnabled}
              onValueChange={toggleSound}
              trackColor={{ false: '#cbd5e1', true: '#b8d6f0' }}
              thumbColor={soundEnabled ? '#004b87' : '#f8fafc'}
            />
          </View>

          <View style={[styles.switchRow, { borderBottomWidth: 0 }]}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 10 }}>
              <Text style={styles.switchTitle}>Haptic Vibration Feedback</Text>
              <Text style={styles.switchDetail}>Trigger tactile vibration alert on scan success or gate anomaly</Text>
            </View>
            <Switch
              value={hapticEnabled}
              onValueChange={toggleHaptic}
              trackColor={{ false: '#cbd5e1', true: '#b8d6f0' }}
              thumbColor={hapticEnabled ? '#004b87' : '#f8fafc'}
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* 3. Hardware Identity & Campus Geofence */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.cardHeaderRow}>
            <Ionicons name="hardware-chip-outline" size={18} color="#004b87" />
            <Text style={styles.cardHeaderTitle}>HARDWARE BINDING & GEOFENCE</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.deviceInfoBox}>
            <Text style={styles.deviceInfoLabel}>TERMINAL HARDWARE UUID</Text>
            <Text style={styles.deviceInfoValue} numberOfLines={1} ellipsizeMode="middle">
              {hardwareUuid || 'Hardware not registered'}
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.deviceInfoSub}>
              Tied to Civil Service Form 48 daily time record to prevent proxy scanning.
            </Text>
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.actionOutlineBtn}
            onPress={handleTestGeofence}
            disabled={testingPing}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
          >
            {testingPing ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#004b87" />
            ) : (
              <>
                <Ionicons name="navigate-outline" size={16} color="#004b87" />
                <Text style={styles.actionOutlineBtnText}>Test Campus Boundary Verification</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* 4. Local Storage & Offline Queue Management */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.cardHeaderRow}>
            <Ionicons name="cloud-offline-outline" size={18} color="#004b87" />
            <Text style={styles.cardHeaderTitle}>LOCAL STORAGE & QUEUE</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.offlineStatusBox}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.offlineCountTitle}>{offlineCount} Records Pending</Text>
              <Text style={styles.offlineCountSub}>
                Attendance scans cached offline when campus Wi-Fi drops
              </Text>
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.syncBtn, offlineCount === 0 && styles.btnDisabled]}
              onPress={handleManualSync}
              disabled={offlineCount === 0 || syncingOffline}
              activeOpacity={0.8}
            >
              {syncingOffline ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#ffffff" />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Ionicons name="cloud-upload" size={14} color="#ffffff" />
                  <Text style={styles.syncBtnText}>Upload</Text>
                </>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* 5. Network Gateway & Server IP */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.cardHeaderRow}>
            <Ionicons name="globe-outline" size={18} color="#004b87" />
            <Text style={styles.cardHeaderTitle}>NETWORK SERVER HOST</Text>
          </View>

          <Text style={styles.networkSubText}>
            Points the mobile application to the school's local or cloud Django server endpoint[cite: 14].
          </Text>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.configServerBtn}
            onPress={() => setConfigVisible(true)}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
          >
            <Ionicons name="server-outline" size={16} color="#004b87" />
            <Text style={styles.configServerBtnText}>Configure Backend Host IP</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* 6. Account Exit */}
        <View style={[styles.card, { borderColor: '#fecaca', backgroundColor: '#fffafa' }]}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.logoutBtn} onPress={confirmSignOut} activeOpacity={0.8}>
            <Ionicons name="log-out-outline" size={18} color="#dc2626" />
            <Text style={styles.logoutBtnText}>Log Out from this Device</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Server Config Modal */}
      <ServerConfigModal visible={configVisible} onClose={() => setConfigVisible(false)} />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

// mobile/src/screens/SmsLogsScreen.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  FlatList,
  RefreshControl,
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/theme';

interface SmsItem {
  id: number;
  recipient_name: string;
  recipient_number: string;
  message_body: string;
  status: 'PENDING' | 'SENT' | 'FAILED' | string;
  created_at: string;
  trigger_event?: string;
  error_message?: string | null;
  retry_count?: number;
}

export const SmsLogsScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<SmsItem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [retryingId, setRetryingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'PENDING' | 'SENT' | 'FAILED'>('ALL');

  const fetchDatabaseSms = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const url =
        statusFilter === 'ALL'
          ? '/api/sms-outbox/'
          : `/api/sms-outbox/?status=${statusFilter}`;
      const response = await apiClient.get(url);
      const data = response.data?.results || response.data || [];
      setLogs(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg =
        err?.response?.data?.error ||
        err?.response?.data?.detail ||
        'Unable to connect to the SMS outbox database.';
      Alert.alert('Database Notice', msg);
      setLogs([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [statusFilter]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true);
    fetchDatabaseSms();
  }, [fetchDatabaseSms]);

  const handleDeleteDelivered = () => {
    Alert.alert(
      'Clean Delivered Messages',
      'Do you want to purge sent SMS records from the database outbox?',
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Clear Sent',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: async () => {
            try {
              const res = await apiClient.post('/api/sms-outbox/delete-delivered/');
              Alert.alert('Outbox Cleaned', res.data?.message || 'Delivered records removed.');
              fetchDatabaseSms();
            } catch {
              Alert.alert('Error', 'Could not delete delivered SMS records.');
            }
          },
        },
      ]
    );
  };

  const handleRetrySingle = async (id: number) => {
    setRetryingId(id);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`/api/sms-outbox/${id}/retry/`);
      Alert.alert('Message Re-queued', 'SMS has been marked PENDING for GSM modem transmission.');
      fetchDatabaseSms();
    } catch {
      Alert.alert('Retry Failed', 'Unable to queue SMS for re-transmission.');
    } finally {
      setRetryingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRetryAllFailed = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/api/sms-outbox/retry-all-failed/');
      Alert.alert('Batch Retry Queued', `Re-queued ${res.data?.count || 0} failed messages.`);
      fetchDatabaseSms();
    } catch {
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Could not re-queue failed messages.');
    }
  };

  const filteredLogs = logs.filter((item) => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!q) return true;
    return (
      (item.recipient_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (item.recipient_number || '').includes(q) ||
      (item.message_body || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (item.trigger_event || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  });

  const failedCount = logs.filter((item) => item.status === 'FAILED').length;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      {/* Top Header */}
      <View style={styles.topHeader}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Text style={styles.screenTitle}>SMS Dispatch Outbox</Text>
          <Text style={styles.screenSub}>Turnstile Notifications & Automated Parent Alerts</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.headerBadge}>
          <View style={styles.activeDot} />
          <Text style={styles.headerBadgeText}>GSM MODEM</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.contentWrap}>
        {/* Controls Row: Search & Action Buttons */}
        <View style={styles.searchRow}>
          <View style={styles.searchBox}>
            <Ionicons name="search-outline" size={17} color="#94a3b8" />
            <TextInput
              style={styles.searchInput}
              placeholder="Search parent number, student, or text..."
              placeholderTextColor="#94a3b8"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
              autoCapitalize="none"
              autoCorrect={false}
            />
            {searchQuery.length > 0 && (
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSearchQuery('')}>
                <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={16} color="#94a3b8" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.cleanBtn}
            onPress={handleDeleteDelivered}
            activeOpacity={0.75}
            accessibilityLabel="Purge Delivered SMS"
          >
            <Ionicons name="trash-outline" size={18} color="#dc2626" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* Filter Pills */}
        <View style={styles.filterPillsRow}>
          {(['ALL', 'PENDING', 'SENT', 'FAILED'] as const).map((filter) => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={filter}
              style={[styles.filterPill, statusFilter === filter && styles.filterPillActive]}
              onPress={() => setStatusFilter(filter)}
              activeOpacity={0.7}
            >
              <Text
                style={[
                  styles.filterPillText,
                  statusFilter === filter && styles.filterPillTextActive,
                ]}
              >
                {filter}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}

          {failedCount > 0 && statusFilter === 'FAILED' && (
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.retryAllBtn}
              onPress={handleRetryAllFailed}
              activeOpacity={0.8}
            >
              <Ionicons name="refresh" size={12} color="#ffffff" />
              <Text style={styles.retryAllBtnText}>Retry All</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Message Records List */}
        {loading ? (
          <View style={styles.centerBox}>
            <ActivityIndicator color={COLORS.primary} size="large" />
            <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Fetching SMS queue from database...</Text>
          </View>
        ) : filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.emptyBox}>
            <Ionicons name="mail-open-outline" size={44} color="#cbd5e1" />
            <Text style={styles.emptyTitle}>No Matching SMS Logs</Text>
            <Text style={styles.emptySub}>
              Automated notifications sent upon student campus turnstile taps or announcements will appear here.
            </Text>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.refreshBtn}
              onPress={fetchDatabaseSms}
              activeOpacity={0.8}
            >
              <Ionicons name="refresh" size={14} color="#ffffff" style={{ marginRight: 4 }} />
              <Text style={styles.refreshBtnText}>Reload Outbox</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <FlatList
            data={filteredLogs}
            keyExtractor={(item) => String(item.id)}
            contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
            showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
            refreshControl={
              <RefreshControl
                refreshing={refreshing}
                onRefresh={() => {
                  setRefreshing(true);
                  fetchDatabaseSms();
                }}
                colors={[COLORS.primary]}
              />
            }
            renderItem={({ item }) => {
              const isSent = item.status === 'SENT';
              const isFailed = item.status === 'FAILED';
              const isPending = item.status === 'PENDING';

              const formattedDate = item.created_at
                ? new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleString('en-US', {
                    month: 'short',
                    day: 'numeric',
                    hour: '2-digit',
                    minute: '2-digit',
                  })
                : 'Just now';

              return (
                <View style={styles.logCard}>
                  <View style={styles.logCardHeader}>
                    <View style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 8 }}>
                      <Text style={styles.logStudentName} numberOfLines={1}>
                        {item.recipient_name || 'Parent / Guardian'}
                      </Text>
                      <Text style={styles.logParentPhone}>{item.recipient_number}</Text>
                    </View>

                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.statusBadge,
                        isSent && styles.statusSuccess,
                        isFailed && styles.statusFailed,
                        isPending && styles.statusPending,
                      ]}
                    >
                      <Text
                        style={[
                          styles.statusBadgeText,
                          isSent && styles.statusSuccessText,
                          isFailed && styles.statusFailedText,
                          isPending && styles.statusPendingText,
                        ]}
                      >
                        {item.status}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  </View>

                  <View style={styles.bubbleBox}>
                    <Text style={styles.bubbleText}>{item.message_body}</Text>
                  </View>

                  {item.error_message ? (
                    <View style={styles.errorBanner}>
                      <Ionicons name="alert-circle" size={13} color="#b91c1c" />
                      <Text style={styles.errorText} numberOfLines={2}>
                        {item.error_message}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  ) : null}

                  <View style={styles.logFooterRow}>
                    <View style={styles.timestampWrap}>
                      <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={12} color="#94a3b8" />
                      <Text style={styles.timestampText}>{formattedDate}</Text>
                    </View>

                    {isFailed && (
                      <TouchableOpacity
                        style={styles.retrySingleBtn}
                        onPress={() => handleRetrySingle(item.id)}
                        disabled={retryingId === item.id}
                        activeOpacity={0.75}
                      >
                        {retryingId === item.id ? (
                          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#004b87" />
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <Ionicons name="refresh" size={12} color="#004b87" />
                            <Text style={styles.retrySingleBtnText}>Resend</Text>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    )}
                  </View>
                </View>
              );
            }}
          />
        )}
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

// AttendSure V3 - Mobile Authentication Service
// File: mobile/src/services/authService.ts

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import * as SecureStore from 'expo-secure-store';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { AuthResponse, UserAccount } from '../types';

const TOKEN_KEY = 'attendsure_auth_token';
const USER_KEY = 'attendsure_user_data';

// Web and native safe storage adapter
const safeStorage = {
  async get(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      try {
        return localStorage.getItem(key);
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }
    return await SecureStore.getItemAsync(key);
  },

  async set(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
      } catch {
        // Fallback for private browsing
      }
      return;
    }
    await SecureStore.setItemAsync(key, value);
  },

  async delete(key: string): Promise<void> {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(key);
      } catch {
        // Fallback
      }
      return;
    }
    await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(key);
  },
};

export const getStoredToken = async (): Promise<string | null> => {
  return await safeStorage.get(TOKEN_KEY);
};

export const storeAuthSession = async (token: string, user: UserAccount): Promise<void> => {
  await safeStorage.set(TOKEN_KEY, token);
  await safeStorage.set(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
  apiClient.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Token ${token}`;
};

export const getStoredUser = async (): Promise<UserAccount | null> => {
  const raw = await safeStorage.get(USER_KEY);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const clearAuthSession = async (): Promise<void> => {
  await safeStorage.delete(TOKEN_KEY);
  await safeStorage.delete(USER_KEY);
  delete apiClient.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
};

export const loginApi = async (username: string, password: string): Promise<AuthResponse> => {
  const response = await apiClient.post<AuthResponse>(ENDPOINTS.LOGIN, {
    username,
    password,
  });
  return response.data;
};

export const fetchCurrentProfile = async (): Promise<UserAccount> => {
  const response = await apiClient.get<UserAccount>(ENDPOINTS.CURRENT_USER);
  return response.data;
};

import * as SecureStore from 'expo-secure-store';

const SERVER_URL_KEY = 'attendsure_dynamic_server_url';
const DEFAULT_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL || 'http://10.16.115.49:8000';

export async function getServerBaseUrl(): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const savedUrl = await SecureStore.getItemAsync(SERVER_URL_KEY);
    return savedUrl ? savedUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '') : DEFAULT_URL;
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_URL;
  }
}

export async function setServerBaseUrl(newUrl: string): Promise<void> {
  const sanitized = newUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
  await SecureStore.setItemAsync(SERVER_URL_KEY, sanitized);
}

export async function resetServerBaseUrl(): Promise<void> {
  await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(SERVER_URL_KEY);
}

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

// Safe loaders for Expo hardware modules
let Device: any = null;
let Application: any = null;

try {
  Device = require('expo-device');
} catch {
  // Graceful fallback if expo-device is unavailable
}

try {
  Application = require('expo-application');
} catch {
  // Graceful fallback if expo-application is unavailable
}

const DEVICE_ID_STORAGE_KEY = '@attendsure_device_uuid';

export interface DeviceHardwareInfo {
  client_device_id: string;
  deviceId: string;
  brand: string | null;
  device_model: string | null;
  deviceModel: string | null;
  modelName: string | null;
  osName: string | null;
  osVersion: string | null;
  isPhysicalDevice: boolean;
}

/**
 * Gets or creates a stable hardware ID for this phone.
 */
export const getOrCreateDeviceId = async (): Promise<string> => {
  try {
    // 1. Try native Android ID
    if (Platform.OS === 'android' && Application?.getAndroidId) {
      const androidId = Application.getAndroidId();
      if (androidId) {
        return `PHONE-ANDROID-${androidId.toUpperCase()}`;
      }
    }

    // 2. Try native iOS Identifier
    if (Platform.OS === 'ios' && Application?.getIosIdForVendorAsync) {
      const iosId = await Application.getIosIdForVendorAsync();
      if (iosId) {
        return `PHONE-IOS-${iosId.toUpperCase()}`;
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback to cached ID in storage
    const storedId = await AsyncStorage.getItem(DEVICE_ID_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (storedId) {
      return storedId;
    }

    // 4. Generate and save a new persistent device ID
    const randomHex = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10);
    const newId = `PHONE-${Platform.OS.toUpperCase()}-${randomHex.toUpperCase()}`;
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(DEVICE_ID_STORAGE_KEY, newId);
    return newId;
  } catch {
    return `PHONE-${Platform.OS.toUpperCase()}-CLIENT-ID`;
  }
};

/**
 * Reads phone hardware information for device binding.
 */
export const getDeviceHardwareInfo = async (): Promise<DeviceHardwareInfo> => {
  const deviceId = await getOrCreateDeviceId();

  const brand = Device?.brand || (Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'Apple' : 'Android');
  const modelName = Device?.modelName || Device?.designName || Device?.productName || Platform.OS;
  const deviceModel = modelName;
  const osName = Device?.osName || Platform.OS;
  const osVersion = Device?.osVersion ? String(Device.osVersion) : String(Platform.Version);
  const isPhysicalDevice = Device?.isDevice ?? true;

  return {
    client_device_id: deviceId,
    deviceId: deviceId,
    brand,
    device_model: deviceModel,
    deviceModel: deviceModel,
    modelName,
    osName,
    osVersion,
    isPhysicalDevice,
  };
};

// Aliases for compatibility across older screens
export const getDeviceIdentity = getDeviceHardwareInfo;
export const getDeviceId = getOrCreateDeviceId;

export default {
  getDeviceHardwareInfo,
  getDeviceIdentity,
  getDeviceId,
  getOrCreateDeviceId,
};

FILE: .\mobile\src\services\offlineQueue.ts

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import * as Crypto from 'expo-crypto';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';

const STORAGE_QUEUE_KEY = '@attendsure_offline_telemetry_v1';

export interface QueuedTelemetryItem {
  requestId: string;
  payload: {
    client_device_id: string;
    latitude: number;
    longitude: number;
    battery_level: number;
    is_mock_location: boolean;
  };
  queuedAt: number;
}

/**
 * Saves a telemetry record to on-device storage during network outages.
 */
export async function enqueueOfflineTelemetry(payload: QueuedTelemetryItem['payload']): Promise<string> {
  const requestId = Crypto.randomUUID();
  const queueItem: QueuedTelemetryItem = {
    requestId,
    payload,
    queuedAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const rawQueue = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_QUEUE_KEY);
  const queue: QueuedTelemetryItem[] = rawQueue ? JSON.parse(rawQueue) : [];
  queue.push(queueItem);

  await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(queue));
  return requestId;
}

/**
 * Returns the number of unsynced items stored locally.
 */
export async function getUnsyncedCount(): Promise<number> {
  const rawQueue = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_QUEUE_KEY);
  if (!rawQueue) return 0;
  const queue: QueuedTelemetryItem[] = JSON.parse(rawQueue);
  return queue.length;
}

/**
 * Dispatches all pending telemetry records to the server in chronological order.
 */
export async function flushOfflineTelemetryQueue(): Promise<{ sent: number; remaining: number }> {
  const rawQueue = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_QUEUE_KEY);
  if (!rawQueue) return { sent: 0, remaining: 0 };

  const queue: QueuedTelemetryItem[] = JSON.parse(rawQueue);
  if (queue.length === 0) return { sent: 0, remaining: 0 };

  const remainingItems: QueuedTelemetryItem[] = [];
  let sentCount = 0;

  for (const item of queue) {
    try {
      await apiClient.post(ENDPOINTS.TELEMETRY_HEARTBEAT, {
        ...item.payload,
        request_id: item.requestId,
      });
      sentCount++;
    } catch {
      // Retain the item if network drops mid-sync
      remainingItems.push(item);
    }
  }

  await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(remainingItems));
  return { sent: sentCount, remaining: remainingItems.length };
}

// mobile/src/services/soundService.ts

import { Vibration, Platform } from 'react-native';

let AudioModule: any = null;
let FileSystemModule: any = null;
let isAudioAvailable = false;

try {
  const expoAv = require('expo-av');
  if (expoAv && expoAv.Audio) {
    AudioModule = expoAv.Audio;
    isAudioAvailable = true;
  }
} catch {
  isAudioAvailable = false;
}

try {
  FileSystemModule = require('expo-file-system');
} catch {
  FileSystemModule = null;
}

let isAudioConfigured = false;

const configureAudio = async () => {
  if (!isAudioAvailable || !AudioModule || isAudioConfigured) return;
  try {
    await AudioModule.setAudioModeAsync({
      playsInSilentModeIOS: true,
      staysActiveInBackground: false,
      shouldDuckAndroid: true,
      playThroughEarpieceAndroid: false, // Forces audio to external speaker
    });
    isAudioConfigured = true;
  } catch {
    // Ignore audio config error
  }
};

// Reliable CDN Fallback Audio for Android MediaPlayer
const SOUND_URLS = {
  success: 'https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/communication/beep_short.ogg',
  warning: 'https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/alarms/alarm_clock.ogg',
  error: 'https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/cartoon/cartoon_boing.ogg',
};

// Base64 WAV buffers for offline local caching
const BASE64_TONES = {
  success:
    'UklGRjQBAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAQB8AAEAfAAABAAgAZGF0YRABAACAgICAgICAgICAgICAf39/f3+AgICAgIB/f39/f4CAgICAgH9/f39/gICAgICAf39/f3+AgICAgIB/f39/f4CAgICAgH9/f39/gICAgICAf39/f3+AgICAgIB/f39/f4CAgICAgH9/f39/gICAgICAf39/f3+AgICAgIB/f39/f4CAgICAgH9/f39/gICAgICA',
  warning:
    'UklGRjQBAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAQB8AAEAfAAABAAgAZGF0YRABAADAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMC/v7+/v8DAwMDAwL+/v7+/wMDAwMDAv7+/v7/AwMDAwMC/v7+/v8DAwMDAwL+/v7+/wMDAwMDAv7+/v7/AwMDAwMC/v7+/v8DAwMDAwL+/v7+/wMDAwMDAv7+/v7/AwMDAwMC/v7+/v8DAwMDAwL+/v7+/wMDAwMDAv7+/v7/AwMDAwMA',
  error:
    'UklGRjQBAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAQB8AAEAfAAABAAgAZGF0YRABAADg4ODg4ODg4ODg4ODg39/f39/g4ODg4ODf39/f3+Dg4ODg4N/f39/f4ODg4ODg39/f39/g4ODg4ODf39/f3+Dg4ODg4N/f39/f4ODg4ODg39/f39/g4ODg4ODf39/f3+Dg4ODg4N/f39/f4ODg4ODg39/f39/g4ODg4ODf39/f3+Dg4ODg4N/f39/f4ODg4ODg',
};

const getPlayableUri = async (type: 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'): Promise<string> => {
  if (FileSystemModule && FileSystemModule.cacheDirectory) {
    try {
      const fileUri = `${FileSystemModule.cacheDirectory}attendsure_${type}.wav`;
      const fileInfo = await FileSystemModule.getInfoAsync(fileUri);
      if (!fileInfo.exists) {
        await FileSystemModule.writeAsStringAsync(fileUri, BASE64_TONES[type], {
          encoding: FileSystemModule.EncodingType.Base64,
        });
      }
      return fileUri;
    } catch {
      // Fallback to URL
    }
  }
  return SOUND_URLS[type];
};

const playSoundSafely = async (
  type: 'success' | 'warning' | 'error',
  vibratePattern: number | number[]
) => {
  // Always trigger vibration as tactile backup
  Vibration.vibrate(vibratePattern);

  if (!isAudioAvailable || !AudioModule) return;

  try {
    await configureAudio();
    const sourceUri = await getPlayableUri(type);
    const { sound } = await AudioModule.Sound.createAsync(
      { uri: sourceUri },
      { shouldPlay: true, volume: 1.0 }
    );
    sound.setOnPlaybackStatusUpdate((status: any) => {
      if (status.isLoaded && status.didJustFinish) {
        sound.unloadAsync();
      }
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[Audio Notice] Sound playback skipped: ${err}`);
  }
};

export const playScanSuccessSound = async () => {
  await playSoundSafely('success', 70);
};

export const playScanWarningSound = async () => {
  await playSoundSafely('warning', [0, 150, 80, 150]);
};

export const playScanErrorSound = async () => {
  await playSoundSafely('error', [0, 200, 100, 200]);
};

import * as Location from 'expo-location';
import * as Battery from 'expo-battery';
import * as Crypto from 'expo-crypto';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { enqueueOfflineTelemetry, flushOfflineTelemetryQueue } from './offlineQueue';

export async function sendLiveHeartbeat(deviceId: string) {
  // Check location permission
  const { status } = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();
  if (status !== Location.PermissionStatus.GRANTED) {
    throw new Error('Location permission is required for campus telemetry.');
  }

  // 1. Read real device sensors
  const location = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
    accuracy: Location.Accuracy.High,
  });

  const batteryFraction = await Battery.getBatteryLevelAsync();
  const batteryLevel = batteryFraction >= 0 ? Math.round(batteryFraction * 100) : 100;
  const isMock = Boolean(location.mocked);

  const payload = {
    client_device_id: deviceId,
    latitude: location.coords.latitude,
    longitude: location.coords.longitude,
    battery_level: batteryLevel,
    is_mock_location: isMock,
  };

  const requestId = Crypto.randomUUID();

  try {
    // Attempt real-time push to the ingestion endpoint
    const response = await apiClient.post(ENDPOINTS.TELEMETRY_HEARTBEAT, {
      ...payload,
      request_id: requestId,
    });

    // Check for and flush any previously saved offline items
    flushOfflineTelemetryQueue().catch(() => {});

    return {
      status: response.data.status,
      isQueuedOffline: false,
      requestId,
    };
  } catch {
    // Save to phone storage if network is offline or server is unreachable
    await enqueueOfflineTelemetry(payload);

    return {
      status: 'STORED_OFFLINE',
      isQueuedOffline: true,
      requestId,
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Safely parses Django ISO, UTC, or SQLite date strings into human-readable 12-hour time.
 */
export function formatScanTime(rawDate?: string | null): string {
  if (!rawDate) return '--:--';

  try {
    // Replace space with 'T' to standardize SQLite timestamps: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss' -> ISO
    const standardized = rawDate.includes('T') ? rawDate : rawDate.replace(' ', 'T');
    const parsed = new Date(standardized);

    if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
      return parsed.toLocaleTimeString([], {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: true,
      });
    }

    // Fallback regex if phone runtime timezone fails to parse
    const timeMatch = rawDate.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
    if (timeMatch) {
      const hours = parseInt(timeMatch[1], 10);
      const minutes = timeMatch[2];
      const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
      const formattedHours = hours % 12 || 12;
      return `${formattedHours}:${minutes} ${ampm}`;
    }
  } catch {
    // Return empty fallback instead of crash
  }

  return '--:--';
}

/**
 * Formats distance with appropriate units (meters vs kilometers).
 */
export function formatDistance(meters: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (meters === null || meters === undefined || isNaN(meters)) return 'Determining distance...';
  if (meters < 1000) {
    return `${Math.round(meters)} m`;
  }
  return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(2)} km`;
}

          if (!box) {
            box = document.createElement('div');
            box.id = 'tv-error-box';
            box.style.cssText =
              'position:fixed;top:12px;left:12px;right:12px;background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b;padding:14px 18px;border:2px solid #ef4444;border-radius:8px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;z-index:999999;box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;word-break:break-all;';

            '<div style="flex:1;">' +
            '<div style="font-weight:bold;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px;color:#b91c1c;">' + title + '</div>' +
            '<div>' + detail + '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<button onclick="this.parentElement.remove()" style="background:#b91c1c;color:#ffffff;border:none;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;font-size:12px;flex-shrink:0;">Dismiss</button>';
        }

        window.onerror = function (msg, url, lineNo, colNo, error) {
          var location = (url ? url.split('/').pop() : 'script') + ':' + lineNo;
          displayError('Application Script Error', msg + ' (' + location + ')');
          return false;
        };

        window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', function (event) {
          var reason = event.reason;
          var msg = reason && (reason.message || reason.statusText || reason) ? (reason.message || reason.statusText || reason) : 'Unhandled Async Rejection';
          displayError('Async / Network Error', msg);
        });
      })();

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js
export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...

      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this
      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,
      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules
      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,
      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules
      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,

      // Other configs...
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

You can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import reactX from 'eslint-plugin-react-x'
import reactDom from 'eslint-plugin-react-dom'

export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...
      // Enable lint rules for React
      reactX.configs['recommended-typescript'],
      // Enable lint rules for React DOM
      reactDom.configs.recommended,
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```
